why_agent_cannot: confirm the domain against the project's own profile before touching it (forensics flags it)
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://airdrop.korprotocol.foundation   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the KOR Airdrop site Go to the KOR Airdrop site , which invites you to verify your activity and unlock a KOR token reward, and press Enter.
2 Step 2 : Connect an EVM wallet On the flow page , connect your EVM wallet to register for the KOR airdrop.
3 Step 3 : Complete the Proof of Humanity stage The flow's second stage is called Proof of Humanity. The airdrop site does not describe what it asks for, so follow the prompts it shows.
4 Step 4 : Fill in your registration info and finish The last two stages are registration info and registration complete. Finish both to complete your registration.
